figurative_meaning_en: blunt and choppy, lacking sweetness or flavor, rudely straightforward
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথা চাঁছাছোলা, কোনো মিষ্টতা নেই।
চাঁছাছোলা ভাবে সত্য বললে মন খারাপ হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: His speech is choppy and blunt, without any sweetness.
Speaking in a rudely straightforward way upsets people.
note: Often used to describe harsh or unpolished speech patterns in everyday Bengali communication
